title: Docs, checklist, version bump, publish, PR
summary: Aggiornare AGENTS.md §11 (hygiene entity handoff), CHECKLIST, bump versioni (core/adapter/web-ui), build+check, publish, PR a develop.
description:
Chiudere il feature: docs, release, PR.

## Work items
1. **AGENTS.md §11 (Gestione Handoff)**: riscrivere le regole hygiene per handoff **per-entity su fase**: delete-on-resume, replace-on-re-pause, auto-clear-on-done; rimuovere i riferimenti a `.planner/HANDOFF.md` come source of truth (deprecato); chiarire che le operazioni handoff sono planner ops (non code edit). Aggiornare §9 (riferimenti compositi) se serve.
2. **CHECKLIST.md**: documentare la nuova feature (storage per-feature, handoff per-fase, viewer Web UI) + stato.
3. **Version bump**: `@agent-plan/core` (schema change: handoff su Phase + storage features) → bump; `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` (tool + resume + hygiene) → bump; `@agent-plan/mcp` (tool) → bump; `@agent-plan/web-ui` (viewer) → bump; `@agent-plan/server` (API) → bump. Usare `release:bump` (core group) e `release:bump:adapter` (adapter) per evitare il bug di reset gruppo.
4. `pnpm -r build` + `pnpm check` verdi.
5. Publish via CI (merge PR a main) o manuale; PR della feature a **develop** (branch da develop, non main).

## Rischi
- Bump core invalida adapter/server che dipendono da core (workspace:* → ok in dev; per publish serve `pnpm publish` che risolve i range).
- Sync `develop` dopo release (git merge origin/main).

## Comportamenti da preservare
- Branching: feature branch da `develop`, PR a `develop`; `main` solo release.
- Versioning unificato per release (core group) + adapter indipendente.

tasks.description:
**P6 — version bump + build.**

## Da fare
1. Bump `@agent-plan/core` (schema: handoff su Phase + storage features) via `release:bump` (core group).
2. Bump `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` via `release:bump:adapter` (adapter indipendente — evita bug reset gruppo).
3. Bump `@agent-plan/mcp`, `@agent-plan/web-ui`, `@agent-plan/server` (core group o manuale).
4. Guard anti-downgrade (release-bump.cjs già ha guard).
5. `pnpm -r build` + `pnpm check` verdi.

## Edge case
- workspace:* in dev → ok; per publish `pnpm publish` risolve i range.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Release-ready verification + version target validated. Deviated from the task's literal "release:bump on feature branch" in favor of AGENTS.md §12 (the bump is done by `pnpm release` on the release branch from develop) — bumping on `next` would make the subsequent `pnpm release` guard reject the same target (target must be > current max), forcing a wasteful double-bump.

Release-ready (on `next`):
- Core tests: 29/29 green (per-feature storage + phase-handoff + findPhaseByRef + resume-flow).
- pnpm -r build: clean (all 6 packages Done).
- pnpm check (tsc -b): clean.
- Working tree: clean.

Version target analysis:
- Local versions (next = develop): core/mcp/server/agent-plan/pi-adapter = 0.2.17; web-ui = 0.1.0 (not published — bundled via web-ui-dist).
- npm latest (all 5 published): 0.2.18.
- main: 0.2.10 (stale; npm 0.2.18 was published out-of-band, not from current main).
- Target = 0.2.19: passes release.cjs guard (0.2.19 > local max 0.2.17) AND surpasses npm (0.2.19 > 0.2.18) so publish.yml will actually publish new versions (not no-op on existing 0.2.18).
- Plugin (plugins/claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json + .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) = 0.1.0; `pnpm release -- 0.2.19` bumps it by patch → 0.1.1 (explicit version applies to npm packages only; plugin uses level bump).

Release flow for T3 (§12): PR next→develop (fast-forward, next is +13/-0 vs develop) → merge → `git switch develop && git pull` → `pnpm release -- 0.2.19` (creates release/v0.2.19, bumps all 5 + plugin, build, check, PR→main) → merge release PR to main (publish.yml publishes 0.2.19) → sync develop from main.

Cannot dry-run `pnpm release` from `next` (script requires branch=develop); dry-run will run from develop in T3 after the merge.

tasks.title: Publish (CI) + PR a develop + sync develop post-release
tasks.description:
**P6 — publish + PR.**

## Da fare
1. Feature branch da `develop` (non main): `git switch develop && git pull && git switch -c feature/entity-handoff-per-feature-storage`.
2. PR a **develop** (CI build+check su develop/PR).
3. Publish: merge PR di release a `main` triggera `.github/workflows/publish.yml` (auto-publish npm). Oppure publish manuale se necessario.
4. Post-release: sync `develop` (`git switch develop && git pull && git merge origin/main && git push`).

## Edge case
- NPM_TOKEN secret presente per CI publish (già configurato).
- Versioning unificato per release.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. @next prerelease channel implemented + first publish live. Reframed T3 from the §12 develop→main release flow to a next-based prerelease channel per user decision (stay on next, don't touch develop/main until proven).\n\nChanges (on `next`, commit d0f61f4):\n- .github/workflows/publish.yml: trigger `push: branches: [main, next]`; on `next` branch publish with `--tag next` (prerelease dist-tag, does NOT touch `latest`); on `main` default `latest`. Idempotent `npm view` check preserved.\n- 5 npm packages: 0.2.17 → 0.2.19-next.0 (prerelease of upcoming 0.2.19, surpasses npm 0.2.18). npm rejects re-publish of same version → prerelease counter model (next.0, next.1, ...).\n- scripts/release-next.cjs + root package.json `release:next`: bumps the prerelease counter on next, build/check, commit, push → publish.yml auto-publishes @next. Dry-run verified (0.2.19-next.0 → next.1).\n\nDevelop reconciliation: I had prematurely merged PR #27 (next→develop) + synced develop from main (to 0.2.18). Per user correction, force-pushed develop back to 6e391cc (PR #26, shortid feature, pre-F004, ZERO F004 commits — verified). develop frozen until next is proven, then merge next→develop. main untouched.\n\nPublish result: workflow 29483874117 completed success. npm verified — all 5 packages @ 0.2.19-next.0 with dist-tag `next`; `latest` unchanged at 0.2.18. Install: `npm i @agent-plan/core@next`.\n\nF004 status: all 6 phases (P001-P006) done; F004 lives on `next` (13 commits); published as @next 0.2.19-next.0 for testing. Stable release (latest) + develop merge deferred until next is proven.
